name: 支护电容
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original interactive defense buff device sprite for a top-down 2D industrial-fantasy action RPG set in abandoned mines. Subject: a LOW SQUAT GUARD CAPACITOR built by miners from salvaged support machinery. A stout vertical emerald-green ceramic capacitor, shorter than a person's knee, is protected by two broad IVORY shield-shaped short support plates folded outward on either side. The central vessel has a clearly readable domed green top and only one narrow recessed emerald luminous seam; the plates are thick physical opaque ceramic-and-steel guards, NOT magical translucent shields. Each plate has a tapered lower point and charcoal backing, hinged to a compact rectangular dark-steel base frame on four stubby feet. One thick copper central coupling, two small stout brace pistons, restrained rivets. Front silhouette resembles a protective shelter with a green energy reservoir at its heart, clearly different from a horizontal pressure cylinder or round turbine. Original handmade mine-support engineering, premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial fantasy, broad elegant material planes, bold clean silhouette readable at 80px, sophisticated ivory/emerald/charcoal palette with tiny copper fittings, restrained worn edges. Camera elevated TOP-DOWN THREE-QUARTER view so the capacitor top and forward braces are both visible, designed to sit directly on a 2D game floor. Entire isolated apparatus centered, all feet and protrusions fully visible with 12% empty margin. Genuine transparent alpha background, ALL solid machine surfaces are fully opaque; only background empty space transparent. Very small contained core glow, no outer aura. No character, hands, scene, floor tile, stone patch, floor decal, large shadow, pedestal, UI prompt, letter E, text, letters, numbers, graphic shield symbol, frame, border, logo, watermark or existing franchise design.
design_role: Interactive defense buff prop; elevated three-quarter; 80px target readability
qa: Viewed source copy. Emerald central capacitor with contained luminous slit, broad ivory physical shield supports and compact feet; real background alpha with opaque machine mass; no UI prompt or baked floor/shadow.
